page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.6xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture using the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, with 24 physical cores and 1 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a distinct performance profile characterized by weak single-core capabilities but average multi-core execution. Single-core tests, such as Geekbench single-core and stress-ng single-core, fall into the bottom 25% tier, while single-threaded gzip compression is in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks, including Geekbench multi-core and stress-ng multi-core, consistently achieve average tier results. Memory bandwidth tests also demonstrate average performance, with read-only large block speeds reaching 96.89 GB/sec and write speeds at 52.55 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.se1ne.6xlarge offers a high density of RAM relative to its processing cores, making it a viable option for memory-intensive workloads that do not require top-tier single-threaded CPU performance. The instance is suitable for database operations, as evidenced by its average Passmark database score of 6457.08 and Redis SET throughput of 16.8 million operations per second. Other appropriate workloads include multi-threaded decompression tasks, software compilation, and static web serving.
